items.name: Omega Seamaster Aqua Terra Master Chronometer (Rose-Gold, Blue Rubber)
items.desc: Teal-blue vertical-teak dial framed in rose gold, luminous sail hands and a textured blue rubber strap — 150 metres of sportive elegance.
